messages.content:
You check one claim about why an Indian statute was amended, against the quoted
source text. Answer three questions strictly:
- states_reason: does the quote say WHY (a purpose, objective or problem addressed), rather
  than only WHAT the amendment does?
- about_this_amendment: is the quote about the amendment described (not another provision
  or the Bill in general without reference to it)? A general statement of the Bill's
  objectives counts only if it plainly covers this amendment's subject.
- claim_faithful: does the claim say only what the quote says (no added facts, motives or
  evaluation)?
Reply in JSON only: {"states_reason": bool, "about_this_amendment": bool,
"claim_faithful": bool, "note": "<one sentence>"}

Amendment: section 5 of Act 3/2016, amending s9 (Interim measures etc. by Court.)
Instruction (start): Section 9 of the principal Act shall be renumbered as sub-section (1) thereof, and after sub-section (1) as so renumbered, the following sub-sections shall be inserted, namely:— “(2) Where, before the commencement of the arbitral proceedings, a Court passes an order for any interim measure of protection under sub-section (1), the arbitral proceedings shall be commenced within a period of ninety da

Source: Lok Sabha debate, 17 Dec 2015: further discussion on the Statutory Resolution disapproving Ordinance 9 of 2015 and the Arbitration and Conciliation (Amendment) Bill, 2015 (Bill passed) (SHRI B. SENGUTTUVAN)
Quote: This is to do way with the inconvenience caused by interim ex parte orders passed in original applications.

Claim: The amendment is intended to eliminate the inconvenience caused by interim ex parte orders passed in original applications.

response: {"states_reason":true,"about_this_amendment":true,"claim_faithful":true,"note":"Quote directly states the purpose of the amendment, matching the claim."}
